1.text: Indirimbo y'Amazamuka.Uwiteka, ibukira Dawidi imibabaro ye yose,

2.text: Yuko yarahiye Uwiteka indahiro,Yahize Intwari ya Yakobo umuhigo,

3.text: Ati “Ni ukuri sinzinjira munsi y'ipfundo ry'inzu yanjye,Sinzurira urutara rwanjye.

4.text: Sinzaha amaso yanjye ibitotsi,N'ibihene byanjye sinzabiha gusinzira,

5.text: Ntarabonera Uwiteka ahantu,Ntarabonera Intwari ya Yakobo ubuturo.”

6.text: Dore twumviye Efurata bakivuga,Twakibonye mu kigarama cy'i Yāri.

7.text: “Twinjire mu buturo bwayo,Dusengere imbere y'intebe y'ibirenge byayo.”

8.text: Uwiteka, haguruka winjire mu buruhukiro bwawe,Wowe ubwawe n'isanduku y'imbaraga zawe.

9.text: Abatambyi bawe bambare gukiranuka,Abakunzi bawe bavuze impundu.

10.text: Ku bwa Dawidi umugaragu wawe,Ntuhēze uwo wasīze.

11.text: Uwiteka yarahiye Dawidi indahiro y'ukuri,Ntazīvuguruza ati“Nzashyira uwo mu mbuto z'umubiri wawe ku ntebe yawe y'ubwami.

12.text: Abana bawe nibitondera isezerano ryanjye,N'ibyo nzahamya nkabigisha,N'abana babo bazicara ku ntebe yawe y'ubwami iteka ryose.”

13.text: Kuko Uwiteka yatoranije Siyoni,Yahashakiye kuba ubuturo bwe.

14.text: Ati “Aha ni ho buruhukiro bwanjye iteka ryose,Aha ni ho nzaba kuko nahashatse.

15.text: Nzaha ibyokurya byaho umugisha mwinshi,Nzahaza abakene baho umutsima.

16.text: Kandi abatambyi baho nzabambika agakiza,Abakunzi banjye baho bazavuza impundu cyane.

17.text: Ni ho nzamereza Dawidi ihembe,Uwo nasīze namwiteguriye itabaza.

18.text: Abanzi be nzabambika isoni.Ariko kuri we ikamba rizarabagirana.”
